The magenta concrete powder pillar is at spawn-relative (7, 2, 6) — the center of the 5-block-tall pillar. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm visual discovery. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance since the pillar is tall and brightly colored. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch leaves with shears causes the birch_leaves block to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts without birch_leaves, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining with shears. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sugar from sugar_cane places sugar into the player's inventory. Sugar is not available anywhere else in this scene (no honey bottles, no other sources), so having ≥1 sugar definitively proves the player collected sugar_cane and crafted it. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_blue_carpet from 2 light_blue_wool places the carpet into the player's inventory. Light blue carpet is not available anywhere else in this scene, so having ≥1 confirms the player opened the chest, retrieved the wool, and successfully crafted the carpet. The recipe yields 3 carpets from 2 wool; checking ≥1 is sufficient.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with a prominent 5-block-tall magenta concrete powder pillar serving as a landmark. Adjacent to the pillar is a birch tree with a full 3x3x2 leaf canopy (mineable with provided shears). Two sugar cane blocks grow on dirt near the birch tree with water adjacency. A chest near the pillar contains 2 light_blue_wool for crafting carpet. Player starts with crafting table and shears in inventory.
task_text: Find the magenta concrete powder landmark pillar. Use your shears to mine birch leaves from the nearby birch tree. Collect sugar cane growing near the tree and craft it into sugar using the crafting table. Open the chest near the landmark to get light blue wool, then craft it into light blue carpet.
